SELECT AVG(rating_avg_duration) AS avg_of_rating_avg_durations, AVG(rating_avg_ratio) AS avg_of_rating_avg_ratios
FROM (
  SELECT rating,
         AVG(rental_duration) AS rating_avg_duration,
         AVG(rental_rate / replacement_cost) AS rating_avg_ratio
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99
  GROUP BY rating
) AS per_rating
